subject: Next steps: VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot — scheduling demo + runbook
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@retailbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next step: VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot

Hi Kelly — thanks again for the 30m today. Quick recap and a concrete next step so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (2 min):
- Discovery: RetailBridge needs sub-50ms tail latency on search reranks for your storefront and safe data controls for PII-sensitive logs.
- Anchor use case: realtime reranking + nightly embedding refresh for personalized search.
- Constraints: air-gapped portion of pipeline for payment card data, procurement needs SOC2+ contract language.

What we recommend next:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO) to lock commitment and unblock procurement — 30m.
2) Technical deep dive + demo (infra + inference runbook) — 60m. We can run the demo against a synthetic slice of your catalog so you can validate throughput and latency.

Ask: can you share a 2–3 person window that works for your VP/CTO this week or next? If easier, here are three slots from our side:
- Wed 9/15, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 9/16, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Mon 9/20, 15:00–15:30 PT

I attached a short runbook + a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) — will tailor once we have exec availability.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: RB-demo-runbook-v1.pdf, RB-MAP-draft.xlsx
From: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@retailbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot

Thanks Logan — great call. I looped in our Head of Platforms (cc: sales_ops) — she coordinates exec calendars. Confirming high-level: we want the exec call first to align timelines before the tech demo.

Our tentative windows (PT):
- Thu 9/16, 11:00–11:30 — possible but tight
- Mon 9/20, 15:00–15:30 — preferred

We also need a short outline of who from your side will attend (VP/CTO or Head of Solutions?). Can you send a 1-line attendee list and the agenda for 30m?

Kelly Turner
Director of Engineering | RetailBridge
kelly.turner@retailbridge.com
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot

Appreciate the quick reply, Kelly — Monday 9/20 15:00 PT works for us. Attendees from Redwood: 
- Marissa Cole (VP, Solutions) — exec alignment & commercial
- Karthik Iyer (Head, Platform Eng) — technical authority for Dedicated/Private deployment options
- Logan Wright (AE) — facilitation + MAP review (me)

Proposed 30m agenda (high-level):
1) 3m quick intros + decision maker ask
2) 8m summary of proposed solution + economics (estimated unit cost and throughput)
3) 12m platform constraints & deployment options (Dedicated vs Private) — Karthik covers technical gating items
4) 5m next steps & procurement runway (MAP owner + timeline)

Marissa — can you be the primary exec for the call? Karthik — please bring the two slide bullets on latency SLOs and security controls.

Kelly — I updated the runbook with a note about the exec call agenda and attached the MAP again. If the Monday slot is final, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Logan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
